notes.title: NEW CHAPTER AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Explore the mysteries of Evil Nun: The Broken Mask's new update! The Pink Room Chapter is now available, offering new challenges and puzzles that will put your skills to the test. But that's not all... venture into William's Memories Room inside the bunker, a distorted version of reality that promises to keep you on edge the whole time. Are you ready to uncover the secrets that lie within? Download the latest update now and find out!

Full changelog 👇

- Significant performance optimization
- Dynamic navmesh generation now takes less time to calculate
- The pathfinding algorithm has been updated to make fewer calls during gameplay
- Precomputed visibility has been enabled to reduce CPU workload
- Draw distance for many objects has been adjusted
- Additional sliders have been added to the Video Menu to enable/disable volumetric clouds and fog.
- Motion Blur can now be adjusted in the Video Menu
- Added content related to the Pink Room chapter
- Added content related to the Door of Memories Part I
- Added a chicken

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052709/3b89f797a954179ea241c7fb9eaadbf1bee68239.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug fixing patch and more performant VRam!
notes.content:
We have fixed minor visual glitches and a glitch regarding the explosive doll that made the game run on very unstable frames per second.

On the other hand, a hand crafted process was made to optimice texture streaming and texture sizes. This should fix texture issues in low VRam pc's and it will make every other pc more performant while retaining almost the exact same high visual fidelity!

Big hug,

SM.

notes.title: Achievement Update: Good or bad kid?
notes.content:
We are excited to announce a new update to #EvilNunTheBrokenMask, featuring a host of new achievements to unlock. As a good kid, you can earn the 'Good boy' achievement by staying in your room and praying, while Sister Madeline comes to check on you. 🙏

On the other hand, if you're feeling daring, you can earn the 'Sacrilege' achievement by breaking all the religious statues around the school, enraging Sister Madeline and putting your survival skills to the test. Will you have what it takes to unlock all the achievements and emerge victorious? Download the update and find out! 🔨

notes.title: The School refit Update Released! Weekly NEW nun-content updates from now on!
notes.content:
The school has a subway system now! No, we are kidding. No subway (yet). But we have added some beautiful signs in order to make the navigation of certain areas easier. Every classroom has a name now, and in the starting building you will see various signs indicating where to find the stairs, the nun rooms, etc. Aside from this, once you complete the Van Escape ending, more areas will be available in the school! Remember that closed garden just outside the laundry? Now you can go there for example.

Aside from this, another major nerf in the ladders has been made. Sister Madeline camped the ladders and now she won't do so. In the rare case that she starts doing so, we have added a little bit of code to kick her out of the ladder.

Aside from this, we are changing the school to offer better navigation and we have started to prepare it for the next SUPER BIG Update: The release of the FIRST CHAPTER! Coming this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052709/184bbeb231df06ad07652baf56d4bf882fcdc98c.jpg[/img]

Here you can find the entire changelog.

- Some strange flowers have grown in certain parts of the school. 
- The school changes after the Van Escape. 
- A lectern in the Studying classroom is now interactable after Van Escape.
- A clock in the waiting room is now interactable after Van Escape.
- Some strange vines have appeared in a garden. What could that be?
- Some lights will switch on once Van Escape is completed
- Added the name of Nuns to and a sign with it to each Nun Room in the first floor.
- Added various signs in the Nun Building and the School indicating spaces and exits.
- The locked colored doors are now disabled until you complete the van Escape.
- You can not trap now Sister Madeline in the bunker area.
- Some preparations have been made in the bunker in order to integrate the chapters once they release.
- The wardrobe in the player room has been changed in order to represent what happens if you hide while Madeline sees you.
- Various minor collision bugs have been fixed.
- Various minor AI bugs have been fixed.
- Various minor baked lighting bugs have been fixed.

That's it for this week's update! We are planning to offer updates every week from now on. Next week we will bring new achievements and challenges to the game!

Behave better, or the lord will punish you again, child.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052709/f3dac0a24bf82cbde291dda9a2c4f38f73cc3a48.png[/img]

notes.title: The Bathroom and Missions Update Released!
notes.content:
Hello children!

Enjoying your time in Eagle Junior High School?

We have been working hard since release to offer you another update. This one fixes a variety of small bugs but also adds a little bit of content. But first, let's talk about the elephant in the room.

That yellow bathroom sign was being used by children to complete BOTH alternative escapes, the front door without alarm and the one with the child escaping on top of the Van. We never intended for players to use this object that way, so to punish bad children we have nerfed the bathroom sign. Now it is a little bit scaled down and as the player you can not collide with it. So no more weird strategies to get thoses endings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052709/be694dd511af1dd38f3e543ea145139ddc6c19fa.jpg[/img]

If you want to complete those endings now... you will need 3 things from Philippa for one and something round from a certain classroom for the other escape. That's all we will say!

On the other hand, we have decided to make the Van Escape mandatory in order to gain access to the bunker. A lot of players were not seeing the van escape content and areas, and as a matter of fact it is also a great introduction to the laundry. If you've played the mobile version, you know the bunker missions are related to the children in the laundry. Making the escape mandatory should make everything crystal clear.

But that is not the only improvement regarding this escape. We have also added a mission system for this escape! The boy with the blue hands will now leave you a new mission once you complete the front door escape, right on your blackboard!

Full changelog:

- Fixed a variety of minor bugs

- Fixed some light glitches

- Nerfed the infamous bathroom sign

- Made a mission system for the Van Escape

- Made the Van Escape ending mandatory in order to gain access to the bunker.

That's all for now! We are already working on TWO bunker chapters. What chapters would you like us to release first?

Big hug!

notes.title: Post Release Hotfix!
notes.content:
Have you been a good child? Too bad, because neither we were. It turns out we forgot some "Dev" code in the game and if someone pressed "T" on their keyboard, Sister Madeline got destroyed to oblivion. That is why she was disappearing in many of your games!

Aside from that, we also hunted some naaasty nasty bugs that were really hard to reproduce from our side, here is the full changelog:

On the other hand, some children want Sister Madeline to have more memory and be faster in Normal mode. [b]What do you think about that?[/b] Is she good as she is for new players or should we make her more pro?

Full changelog: 

- Sister Madeline (SM) now doesn't get destroyed with "T"
- SM can't enter or get stuck in the yet inaccesible chicken and farm area next to the fountain.
- Fixed a bug were SM just stares at you while killing you but never performs the kill.
- SM now has better navigation in ladders and can't get stuck on those. If she does, there is some aditional game code to de-stuck her.
- Fixed a bug were the first electricity lever became inactive if you inserted a Fuse after quickly interacting with the lever.
- Fixed a bug were the prompt "Press TAB to show Questlog" did not appear on certain circumstances.
- Added a promt to invite the player to use the Photomode the first time you can go outside or the first time you access the rooftop. Press "P" to use the photomode. It is amazing!
- New sentence added to the post main door escape cinematic so players understand there are more areas they can explore now, including a new escape!
